text: むしポケモンは　しんかが　はやくて　たのしいよな！

structure.jp: しんかが　はやくて
structure.en: their evolving is fast, and so

patterns.name: 〜は〜が
patterns.span: むしポケモンは　しんかが　はやくて
patterns.explanation: は names the thing being talked about and が picks out the part of it being described. むしポケモンは　しんかが　はやい = 'Bug Pokémon are quick to evolve'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: くて joins a describing word to what follows, here giving a loose reason. はやくて　たのしい = 'fast, and so fun'.

patterns.name: 〜よな
patterns.explanation: よな at the end is casual and asks the listener to agree. たのしいよな = 'they're fun, aren't they!'
